profile_text.body:
Elicit is an AI tool built for scientific research, allowing users to search, summarize, extract data from, and chat with a corpus of over 125 million academic papers. The company describes its platform as being used by over 2 million researchers across both academia and industry.

The core product, also called Elicit, functions as a research assistant with capabilities spanning paper analysis, systematic review support, and academic integrity features. A notable feature the company highlights is Elicit Reports, which the site describes as deeply customizable, allowing users to control which papers are included and what information those reports cover, distinguishing it in the company's framing from other AI tools.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations appear in the available data for Elicit.
